testBounds: Power, network, audio and desktop notification effects use isolated executors. ClamAV scans run against actual files.
Firefox persistent installation needs normal browser approval and signing. The real browser test uses Chromium.
Schedules run while the app is running. Auto-start means starting accepted downloads, not starting at desktop login.
Website crawling is static, bounded and restricted to the selected origin. Live and DRM-protected media are unsupported.
English and Danish are included. Other locales use fallback.
FTP and media resume by restarting capture. Validated HTTP byte ranges resume from saved bytes.
The controlled benchmark does not establish original IDM performance parity or a universal Internet speedup.
